model.architecture: Qwen3.5 vision-language hybrid: 18 GatedDeltaNet linear-attention + 6 full-attention decoder layers; the upstream 3-channel M-RoPE positions are derived in the decoder graph from the runtime's 1-D position; 24-block vision encoder + 2x2 merger at a fixed 256x256 input (64 image tokens); 4096-token exported cache; no MTP

variants.quantization: decoder FULLY_CONNECTED weights fp16 float-casting, output head (decode_logits_output) dynamic int8, token embedding int8 CHANNELWISE; vision encoder and adapter fp16 float-casting; fp32 activation preference on the decoder

recommended.reason: Apple M4 Max, same request: median TTFT 0.26 s on GPU vs 1.54 s on CPU, peak RSS 7.0 GB vs 45.5 GB without a cache folder; engine creation 26.8 s vs 16.3 s. Reference readout on the Mac GPU: 53/53 argmax, max |dp| 0.0062 vs upstream fp32.

platform_notes: Tested on LiteRT-LM 0.17.1 (PyPI) on an Apple M4 Max, CPU and GPU (WebGPU delegate). Galaxy S26 (LiteRT-LM v0.16.0): GPU engine creation did not fit (stopped at 6,396,212 kB VmHWM during the OpenCL set-up of prefill_1024 by a 6,347,656 kB guard); CPU not tried (its XNNPACK cache alone is 6.0 GB).

One 256x256 image first in the prompt, one question per runtime request; the runtime returns the greedy letter, not option probabilities. Probabilities, text-only requests and several questions: reference/decider_litert.py (ai-edge-litert 2.2.0, numpy, Pillow, tokenizers).

XNNPACK unpacks the fp16 weights to fp32: the CPU cache folder holds 6,016,360,768 B for the decoder plus 1,312,687,576 B for the vision encoder and adapter; with the GPU backend the decoder's program cache in that folder grew by 270,663,680 B at every engine creation (LiteRT-LM 0.17.1, Mac) and a warm folder did not shorten GPU engine creation.

known_issues: CPU reference readout: 52/53 argmax on the published image questions (the flip is on a question whose upstream top two options are 0.0073 apart), max |dp| 0.0085.

LiteRT-LM's text-scoring call does not give option probabilities that agree with its own greedy decode on 0.17.1 (https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/issues/3561); read the letter logits with the reference readout.
Text-only prompts start at position 0 in the runtime; the decoder expects them at 65. Send text-only requests through the reference readout.
Inputs other than 224x224, 256x240 or 256x256 get 64 image tokens instead of upstream's 70-475; on the published synthetic rows that moved upstream's own probabilities by up to 0.373 (30/32 argmax).
The runtime's own resize of non-256x256 images was not exercised; resize to 256x256 with PIL bicubic before sending.
